name: Saintsworn Obelisks
desc:
The five Saintsworn Obelisks are NPCs that are required to be located and interacted with to obtain the Saintsworn Oath. These obelisks are based in five elements: Flamecharm, Frostdraw, Thundercall, Galebreathe, and Shadowcast, each inhabited by the soul of [the element's Hero](faction:the_five_heroes).

Obelisks can only be interacted with if you have atleast 15 of their respective element.
additional_info: -   There is a symbol marked on all 4 sides of the base of each obelisk. Curiously, two of these symbols match the emblem of [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority).
